intro.title: Use this phone as a webcam
intro.body: Your camera streams directly to your computer over your local network. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
intro.permissionNote: Camera access is requested only after you tap Start.
intro.warningNote: The security warning before this page is normal. The link is still encrypted.

live.pausedBody: Keep this page open and the screen on while streaming.
live.rotationBody: Turning your phone flips the video on your computer between portrait and landscape.

settings.title: Camera settings
settings.note: Options your camera or browser doesn't support are disabled. Your computer can also change these settings.

no_pairing.title: Scan the QR code
no_pairing.body: Open OpenCamera on your computer, choose “Connect a Device” and scan the QR code with your camera app.

permission_denied.title: Camera access is blocked
permission_denied.body: Tap the icon next to the address bar, open Permissions and allow Camera, then try again.
permission_denied.bodyIos: Open Settings › Safari › Camera and choose Allow, then come back and try again.

no_camera.title: No camera found
no_camera.body: This browser didn't find a usable camera.

camera_busy.title: Camera is in use
camera_busy.body: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.body: Use Safari on iPhone, or Chrome or Firefox on Android, and open the https link from the QR code.

invalid_token.title: This QR code is no longer valid
invalid_token.body: Each code works once and expires after 5 minutes. Scan the new code shown on your computer.

expired_token.title: This QR code has expired
expired_token.body: Each code works once and expires after 5 minutes. Scan the new code shown on your computer.

unknown_device.title: This phone was removed
unknown_device.body: It was removed from OpenCamera on your computer. Scan a new QR code to pair again.

busy.title: Another phone is connected
busy.body: Disconnect the other phone in OpenCamera on your computer, then try again.

version_mismatch.title: Update needed
version_mismatch.body: This page is out of date. Reload it to get the version matching your computer.

replaced.title: Opened somewhere else
replaced.body: OpenCamera is now streaming from another tab or window.

unreachable.title: Can't reach your computer
unreachable.body: Make sure OpenCamera is open on your computer and that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.
